thread:
maya (PM): Quick question from design-review: should the Burst control live on the main autoscale card or be tucked into Advanced?
samir (prod-designer): main card for discoverability, but require confirmation to avoid accidental enable. small inline confirm pattern?
tal (frontend): Prefer toggle that expands an inline panel with slider + confirm. keeps compact default and avoids modals.
liam (eng-run): Fine by me. Backend needs fields: burst_enabled, burst_capacity_percent, allow_fallback flag.
nana (a11y): Accessibility: toggle must have aria-expanded and the expanded panel should move focus to the first input. aria-live for status messages.
samir (prod-designer): Copy suggestion on confirm: "Enable burst for short spikes — approx. +$X/hr" with a docs link. use "approx."
maya (PM): UX for min/max: should users type GPUs or instances?
tal (frontend): Show "Min instances" / "Max instances" with stepper + input. below show "Total GPUs = instances × GPUs per node". validate on blur.
liam (eng-run): If selected model requires 8 GPUs but pool nodes only have 4, grey-out that pool with visible reason. if user overrides, show a warning modal indicating fallback to queued requests or smaller model variant.
nana (a11y): Visible reason must be in DOM for screen readers, not only a hover tooltip. include it in option aria-label.
samir (prod-designer): SLO slider: keep a percent slider but show presets: Low latency (95ms), Balanced (200ms), Cost saver (500ms). make the ms visible.
tal (frontend): Ensure aria-valuetext = "SLO target: 200ms". presets should be buttons with aria-pressed.
liam (eng-run): Backend will accept {"slo_ms":200} or {"slo_preset":"balanced"}. also log preset for analytics.
maya (PM): Guardrail behavior: if pool can't meet selected SLO show inline banner: "This pool may not meet the selected latency. Consider Dedicated." actions: Request Dedicated / Keep config.
samir (prod-designer): If user continues, attach allow_fallback flag so runtime can route to hosted models when queues exceed threshold.
tal (frontend): For min=0 + burst enabled, show helper text: "Zero baseline allowed — burst will create temporary instances (billed while running)." ensure helper is in DOM.
nana (a11y): Helper text must be readable by screen readers and not only in tooltip. use clear language.
maya (PM): Dropdown ordering: default to recommended (latency+cost), allow toggling to "cheapest" or "most used" in dropdown header.
tal (frontend): We'll implement a custom combobox with a tiny header with chips. will test VoiceOver.
deploy-bot: Preview deploy queued: preview/autoscale-burst-ux -> staging. Build #8622.
maya (PM): Thanks — please run keyboard + screen reader pass on the preview and drop any copy nits in Figma."
